nrs-yard-11.see: A wooden sleeping chamber with two fur-covered beds and a stone hearth opens onto an open gravel courtyard containing a central runestone, a birch tree, and outdoor work equipment.
nrs-yard-11.wrong: Top-left debug overlay text; bottom half drops off into an empty dark-grey grid void; runestone carving is an unreadable red knot rather than legible runes; background yellow light bleeds through wall gaps.

nrs-weaving-11.see: A small wooden room with scattered straw flooring houses a large upright warp-weighted loom holding woven striped fabric, a small chest, a sack, and a hinged wooden door.
nrs-weaving-11.wrong: Top-left debug overlay text; straw bedding clips heavily into the base of the walls and door frame; wall-mounted lantern on the left clips into the carved wall seam; scene abruptly cuts off into an empty dark grid at the bottom.

nrs-boathouse-11.see: A wooden workshop contains an unfinished wooden boat hull elevated on trestles, an upright rack of oars or timber ribs, two storage chests, and rolled canvas on sawbucks.
nrs-boathouse-11.focal: Unfinished wooden boat hull on trestles
nrs-boathouse-11.wrong: Top-left debug overlay text; bright lime-green horizontal bar and clipping green polygon artifact across the top; rolled canvas on the left clips through the room boundary; bottom area extends into an empty dark grid.

nrs-smithy-11.see: A compact wooden smithy contains an anvil on a tree stump, a stone hearth forge with twin bellows, a stone water trough, a grindstone station, and a tool chest on a dirt floor.
nrs-smithy-11.focal: Anvil mounted on a wooden stump
nrs-smithy-11.wrong: Top-left debug overlay text; dark floor burn decals appear as flat 2D patches clipping unnaturally over the dirt; bottom area cuts off into empty dark grid tiles.

nrs-longhouse-11.see: A wide timber longhouse room with straw-covered dirt flooring features a central stone fire pit surrounded by five carved support pillars, wall shields, and storage containers.
nrs-longhouse-11.wrong: Top-left debug overlay text; bright lime-green horizontal banner and green polygon artifact above the room; center rear wooden pillar clips directly into a chest; asymmetrical five-pillar layout; bottom area cuts off into an empty dark grid.

nrs-meadhall-11.see: An ornate wooden hall with straw flooring features a carved high seat flanked by two stone hearths, an animal pelt runner, dining benches, a table, and mounted shields.
nrs-meadhall-11.wrong: Top-left debug overlay text; bright lime-green bar and green wireframe artifact at the top; single wooden pillar placed near the right fire pit with no matching pillar on the left; center pelt rug looks blurry and clips into the straw floor; bottom area drops off into an empty dark grid.
